detect_univariate_outliers: run OutlierDetector on a TimeSeriesData object to find univariate outliers using IQR-based seasonal decomposition
detect_multivariate_anomalies: run MultivariateAnomalyDetector with VAR or BayesianVAR model to detect multivariate anomalies across multiple metrics
get_anomaly_timepoints: call get_anomaly_timepoints on a MultivariateAnomalyDetector to retrieve timestamps where p-value falls below a significance threshold
get_anomalous_metrics: call get_anomalous_metrics on a MultivariateAnomalyDetector to find the top k most anomalous metrics at a given time
plot_anomaly_scores: call plot on a MultivariateAnomalyDetector to visualize input metrics and overall anomaly scores for threshold selection
